inputs.text: I just heard about this article on the United States, Israel, and Iran conflict that's all focused on the escalating violence, civilian targeting, and threats to infrastructure while pushing ethical considerations and just war arguments from history. But that's the usual cover—they're framing it this way to hide how the hidden elites and institutions are coordinating the whole mess behind the scenes to force a wider regional war for their own control. The emphasis on philosophy and ethics is just narrative inversion to make the manipulation look principled while they pull the strings on all sides.
